title: Where du'as are accepted
summary: Hazrat's lesson from the story of Hazrat Zakariya and Bibi Maryam: the court of the awliya of Allah is a place where du'as are accepted. And why du'a is the core of worship.

blocks.h: Du'a is the core of worship

blocks.p: Hazrat often reminds his listeners that we worship but forget to ask. He explains the command Ud'uni astajib lakum: 'ask of Me; I will answer you'.

blocks.q: Ad-du'a mukhkh al-'ibadah: du'a is the core of worship. The worship we do is completed by du'a.
Your work is only to pray. Allah's work is to give. I am the one who prays; Allah is the One who gives.

blocks.p: In part 8, Hazrat tells the story of Bibi Maryam. Her parents had vowed to give their child to the service of Allah's house, and she was given a room in the place of worship, where Hazrat Zakariya, her uncle, looked after her.

One day, while they spoke near her room, a gust of wind lifted the curtain, and Hazrat Zakariya saw fruits inside that were out of season. He asked where they came from. She said: 'Allah sends them to me.'

blocks.q: Then, standing right there, he said: Ya Allah, You give Maryam fruit out of season. Now have mercy on me, be generous to me: give me a child out of season.

blocks.p: Allah accepted his du'a at once, and Jibreel brought him the news of a son, Hazrat Yahya. Hazrat points out where this happened: the du'a was made beside Bibi Maryam's room, and she is a waliya of Allah.

blocks.q: The house of Allah is for everyone. But whomever Allah calls His wali, His friend, and is kind to: that is his honour, his good fortune.
The court of the awliya of Allah is the place where Allah accepts du'as. Keep this in mind.

blocks.note: Parts 6 to 9 are not yet public on YouTube, so these passages have no video link yet. Ask your teacher about the adab of making du'a at the courts of the awliya.

ru.title: Duaayein kahaan qabool hoti hain
ru.summary: Hazrat Zakariya aur Bibi Maryam ke qisse se Hazrat ka sabaq: Allah ke auliya ki baargaah woh jagah hai jahaan duaayein qabool hoti hain. Aur dua ibaadat ka maghz kyun hai.

blocks.p: Hazrat aksar sunne waalon ko yaad dilaate hain ke hum ibaadat to karte hain lekin maangna bhool jaate hain. Woh Ud'uni astajib lakum ka hukm samjhaate hain: 'Mujh se maango; main tumhari dua qabool karunga'.

blocks.q: Ad-du'a mukhkh al-'ibadah: dua ibaadat ka maghz hai. Jo ibaadat hum karte hain woh dua se mukammal hoti hai.
Tumhara kaam sirf dua karna hai. Dena Allah ka kaam hai. Main dua karne wala hoon; dene wala Allah hai.

blocks.p: Part 8 mein Hazrat Bibi Maryam ka qissa sunaate hain. Unke waalidain ne mannat maani thi ke apni aulaad ko Allah ke ghar ki khidmat ke liye de denge, aur unko ibaadat-gaah mein ek kamra diya gaya, jahaan unke khaalu Hazrat Zakariya unki dekh-bhaal karte the.

Ek din, jab woh unke kamre ke paas baat kar rahe the, hawa ka ek jhonka aaya aur parda uth gaya, aur Hazrat Zakariya ne andar be-mausam ke mewe dekhe. Unhone poocha yeh kahaan se aaye. Bibi Maryam ne kaha: 'Allah mujhe bhejta hai.'

blocks.q: Phir wahin khade rah kar bole: Ya Allah, Tu Maryam ko be-mausam ke mewe deta hai. Ab mujh par raham farma, karam farma: mujhe be-mausam ki aulaad de.

blocks.p: Allah ne fauran unki dua qabool ki, aur Jibreel ne unko bete, Hazrat Yahya, ki khush-khabri di. Hazrat batate hain ke yeh kahaan hua: dua Bibi Maryam ke kamre ke paas ki gayi thi, aur woh Allah ki waliya hain.

blocks.q: Allah ka ghar to sab ke liye hai, magar Allah jisko wali bole, dost bole, us par meherbaan ho jaaye, to woh uski tauqeer hai, uski khush-naseebi hai.
Auliya Allah ki baargaah Allah Ta'ala ke duaayein qabool karne ka maqaam hai. Iska khayal rahe.

blocks.note: Part 6 se 9 abhi YouTube par public nahin hain, isliye in hisson ka video link abhi nahin hai. Auliya ki baargaah mein dua karne ke aadaab ke baare mein apne ustaad se poochiye.
